Configuration.ScriptBody:
#define the api and propertybag
$api = New-Object -ComObject 'MOM.ScriptAPI'
$PropertyBag=$api.CreatePropertyBag()
#to check the in total cpu usage
$cpuTime = (Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time').CounterSamples.CookedValue
$cpuTime = "{0:N0}" -f $cpuTime
$Percent = '%' $cpuTimePercent = $cpuTime + $Percent #$cpuTimePercent
#To get the top 1 process name which consuming the most CPU resource
#$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$Top1Process = Get-Counter '\Process(*)\% Processor Time' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty countersamples | Select-Object -Property instancename, cookedvalue | Sort-Object -Property cookedvalue -Descending | ? {$_.InstanceName -ne '_total' -and $_.InstanceName -ne 'idle' } |ft InstanceName,@{L='CPU';E={($_.Cookedvalue/100).toString('P')}} -AutoSize | select-object -first 3
$Top1Process | Out-File "C:\Program Files\Top1Process.txt"
$Top1ProcessOutput = gc "C:\Program Files\Top1Process.txt" |Select-Object -last 1
$Top1ProcessName = $Top1ProcessOutput -split ' ' |where {$_.Trim() -ne ''} |Select-Object -first 1
################################################################
#To check if the top 1 process is a OS process or not
$process_path = (get-process $Top1ProcessName |select path).path
if ( $process_path -eq $null ) {
$Is_OS_Process = 'No'}
else {
dir $process_path |fl versioninfo > "C:\Program Files\TempFile.txt" $Process_Owner = get-content "C:\Program Files\TempFile.txt"
$Microsoft_String = "*Microsoft*"
if ($Process_Owner -like $Microsoft_String) {
$Is_OS_Process = 'Yes'}
else { $Is_OS_Process = 'No' } }
################################################################## #to check the precentage of the top 1 process
$Top1ProcessPercetage = $Top1ProcessOutput -split ' ' |where {$_.Trim() -ne ''} |Select-Object -last 1
###################################################################
if($cpuTimePercent -gt '90') { $PropertyBag.AddValue("State","OverUpperThreshold") $PropertyBag.AddValue("cpupercentage",$cpuTimePercent) $PropertyBag.AddValue("TopCpuName",$Top1ProcessName ) $PropertyBag.AddValue("IsOsProcesss", $Is_OS_Process) $PropertyBag.AddValue("Top_Cpu_Value_Percentage", $Top1ProcessPercetage) } elseif($cpuTimePercent -gt '80') { $PropertyBag.AddValue("State","OverMiddleThreshold") $PropertyBag.AddValue("cpupercentage",$cpuTimePercent) $PropertyBag.AddValue("TopCpuName",$Top1ProcessName ) $PropertyBag.AddValue("IsOsProcesss", $Is_OS_Process) $PropertyBag.AddValue("Top_Cpu_Value_Percentage", $Top1ProcessPercetage) } else
{ $PropertyBag.AddValue("State","UnderThreshold")
}
$api.return($PropertyBag) | out-file "C:\windows\temp\\CPUOutput.txt" $PropertyBag
#$api.return($PropertyBag)

DisplayString.Name: Custom CPU Monitor - The CPU usage has exceed the threshold
